# Pre-slab checklist (generated by tools/build_mep.py)

Everything below must be fixed, marked or cast in **before that slab is poured**. Positions are plan X/Y (m) as in the takeoff. All items are ASSUMED proposals: the structural engineer must approve every opening, sleeve, depression and cast-in item, and licensed electrical/plumbing consultants must confirm sizes.

| # | Item | Plan X, Y (m) | Category |
|---|---|---|---|

| 3 | Lift pit: sump/drain + pit light/socket conduit | 4.90, 3.85 | lift |

## Also before the relevant slab or wall work

- Sleeves through external walls for AC copper/drain lines at each AC indoor unit (masonry, can be cored later but cheaper now).
- Brackets/anchors for external stacks S1/W1 (rear, x 3.10/3.30) and S2/W2 (front, x 4.00/4.20), down-takes and rising main.
- Lift: pit depth, shaft size and top overrun from the chosen lift maker before the pit and shaft are built (takeoff Q3).
